title: feat(spec): serve metadata list columns on /meta/types, hook first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDErTg6aA1Xze24mDcUfseY)_
Part of #36860

This is part (a) of the card's two-PR split, which the seat chose when the whole change measured about 3,530 changed lines: the spec declaration, the serving, the header translation, the extractor support and the console precedence, proven end to end on `hook`. Part (b) follows from `main` once this merges and closes the card: the other 26 types, their 52 new header leaves in the 11 `metadata-forms` bundles, the 9 console declarations moved into spec and the duplicate `object` registration resolved.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the served `list` is Studio display data that only the spec registry declares; a metadata author cannot write it, and no skill under `skills/**` teaches Studio list columns (`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` names `entries[].schema` only, unchanged)

## 维护者速读

- 工作室里「钩子」列表的列改由平台规范统一声明，列头随界面语言显示，其他元数据列表暂时不变。
- 属于工作室元数据列表标准化：列定义从控制台代码搬进规范，命令行和 AI 客户端读同一份。
- 只有看钩子列表的管理员会看到列变化；出错时退回原来的默认列，合并后可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Spec (`@objectstack/spec`).** `MetadataListViewSchema` is a list layout bound to the type's own schema (`data: { provider: 'schema', schemaId }`) with `columns`. Each `MetadataListColumnSchema` is `ListColumnSchema` narrowed to `field` / `label` / `type`. `field` is a schema key or a dotted path into it, and `type` is a `MetadataListCellTypeSchema` renderer: `text`, `badge`, `boolean`, `count`, `list` or `summary`. `defineList({ schemaId, columns })` builds one and refuses anything else. `METADATA_LIST_REGISTRY` (`system`) sits beside `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` and declares `hook` here. `resolveMetadataListLabels` translates a list's headers through `metadataForms.<type>.fields.<field>.label`.
- **Serve (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`).** `getMetaTypes()` serves the registry entry as `list` beside `form`, and `GetMetaTypesResponseSchema` declares it. `translateMetaTypesResponse` localizes the headers with the bundle and locale it already uses for `form`. A type with no entry carries no `list` key.
- **i18n (`@objectstack/lint`).** `walkMetadataForms` emits the form field slot for each column path the type's form does not already label, with the header as the English source. `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` names the registry module as a bundle trigger. Every `hook` header reuses a form label, so no bundle changes.
- **Console (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** `ResourceListPage` reads the served columns first (`servedListColumns.tsx`). If the type serves none, it uses the console's `listColumns`, then the default name / label / description. A served header is shown as served. A key the stored row omits shows the schema default at that path. `listCells` overrides a served column's cell and `listExtraColumns` appends server-stamped values that are not schema keys. `builtinComponents.tsx` and `anchors.ts` are not touched here; their 9 declarations move in part (b).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-list-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: every column resolves to a declared, writable, non-retired, non-overlay key of its type's schema. No column is duplicated, and each header equals the form field label or the humanized path. Each refusal has a "gate can fail" pin: an undeclared key, an `_` overlay key, a retired key, an undeclared nested key, and `defineList` refusing `currency`, an empty column list and `width`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-list-layout-36860.test.ts`: every registry type is served with its own frozen layout. The control is a type with no entry, which carries no `list` key.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-types-list-headers.test.ts`: zh-CN headers are translated through the form field slot, dotted path included, and only the header is rewritten. The controls are the en headers, a type serving no list, and no in-place mutation across requests. Ablation: replacing the translate call with `next.list = entry.list` reds the zh-CN case (1 failed, 2 passed), restored by `trap`.
- `ui/.../servedListColumns.test.tsx` covers the renderers, path and default readers and the precedence helpers. `ui/.../ResourceListPage.servedListColumns-36860.test.tsx` mounts the page and checks served headers in order, each renderer, schema defaults for absent keys, a dotted path, the default list as control, a `listCells` override and a `listExtraColumns` column.

## Acceptance notes

- First batch: this PR declares `hook` only, by the seat's split. The keys of all 27 types were checked against their schemas, and the dropped or corrected keys are in the card's thread. They land with part (b).
- `GetMetaTypesResponseSchema` declares `list` but still not `schema` / `form` (pre-existing gap, not widened here).
- The runtime dispatcher's `/metadata/types` path does not translate `form` today, and `list` follows it (pre-existing, unchanged).
- No plugin registrar for list layouts, per the seat route (7122844515).
- Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` reads clean against `main` and the three open PRs sharing files (#36872, #36869, #36857).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`: the precedence expression and `localizeColumnLabel` skipping a served header.
2. `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`: the column step in `walkMetadataForms`. It decides which bundle leaves part (b) adds.
3. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the `pick`/`extend` narrowing behind `defineList`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-types-list-headers.test.ts`. Expect 3 passed, with the zh-CN case reading `['名称', '事件', '最大重试次数']`.

<details><summary>Gates on 597f70e7</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 145 derived, 145 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two findings were fixed in this PR: `check:test-source-alias` (module-top `@objectstack/objectql` import in the new rest test) and `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger rewritten with `--write` for the new metadata-protocol test). Three gates first exited 3 on prerequisites and were re-run green: the plugin-teardown self-test after fetching its pinned fixture commit, and `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after building the packages that had no dist.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date. `check:authorable-surface`, `check:llms-txt`, `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check-i18n-bundles` (no bundle changes), `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-fixed` pass. `check:i18n-coverage` passes after building `service-print`.
- `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: not governed, 1,309 changed lines.
- `tsc --noEmit` is clean for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/lint`. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check was not measured locally because the ui workspace deps have no dist; the only error in the changed files is the shared unresolved `@object-ui/components` import. CI's type-check lane is the verdict.
- Tests: spec `src/system` + `src/api/protocol` 2,941 passed; app-shell `metadata-admin` list and directory pages 221 passed (15 files); `@objectstack/lint` i18n 27; metadata-protocol meta-types 67; rest list headers 3 + schema titles 3.
</details>
